data.long_meaning: Nikita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Niketana', which means 'victory'. In Hindu mythology, Nikita is considered to be a form of the god Shiva's consort Parvati. It is believed that the name bestows strength and the blessings of the god Shiva upon the bearer. The name Nikita carries the meaning “Victory of the God Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nikita usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of the god shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
